test_cases.name: As a Metro by T-Mobile authorized dealer, I want the details of an accessory on the invoice to show Prepaid Tax as its own amount, so that I can explain to the customer exactly what makes up the final price
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## What this test is about
In a Metro by T-Mobile store, a rep (the dealer's employee at the counter) sells phones, plans and small accessories such as cases and speakers. Accessory Sale is the short path for a customer who only wants to buy something off the shelf: the rep puts the items on an invoice, takes the money and hands over a receipt. Some stores charge a second tax on top of the ordinary sales tax. It is called Prepaid Tax, and it appears on the screen as PP Tax. The rep must be able to see it as its own amount, never mixed into the sales tax, and the amount the customer is asked to pay must include it. This test puts one accessory on the invoice and opens its detail panel, which is where the rep sees how the price is built up. It proves the panel lists the item price, the ordinary sales tax and the Prepaid Tax on separate rows, and that the final price is the three added together.

## Related tickets
RTPL-3031 (Implement Prepaid Tax (PP Tax) Calculation), RTPL-1509 (Add PP Tax)

## Preconditions
- The rep is signed in at store EZLOGIC and the environment shown in the user menu reads UAT2.
- The Accessory Sale invoice is empty at the start. If a previous sale is still open on this till, cancel it before beginning.

## Test data
- **Store:** Store EZLOGIC, dealer code 30247306  _(verified: UAT2 2026-10-22, read live in the Accessory Sale screens, shown in the page header after sign-in)_
- **Accessory 1:** Item number BITTYVENOM, Bitty Boomers MARVEL VENOM Bluetooth Speaker, price $19.99, sales tax $2.00, PP Tax $0.20, final price $22.19  _(verified: UAT2 2026-10-22, read live in the Accessory Sale screens)_

## Automation Notes
- CONFIRM BEFORE AUTOMATING: the PP Tax amounts above are what this store charged on 2026-10-22 (1% of each item's price: $0.20 on $19.99 and $0.10 on $9.99). If the store's rate has been changed since, the amounts will differ, so re-read the item detail panel first and update the expected figures.
- If the pinned accessories are out of stock or the amounts differ from this ticket, try another accessory from Browse accessories and recompute from its item detail panel. If you still cannot get matching data, contact the manual QA team to help get working data - do not sit blocked and do not hunt for data alone.
- Never click Collect amount or Submit. The test ends before any payment is taken.

steps.action: Login into the app
steps.expected: The dashboard opens and the header shows STORE ID EZLOGIC and DEALER CODE 30247306.

steps.action: On the dashboard, click the Accessory Sale tile
steps.expected: The Accessory Sale screen opens with the heading ACCESSORY SALE. The left side shows Add accessories with two choices, Scan accessory item and Browse accessories, and a box reading Scan or type item #. The invoice panel on the right is headed Review invoice and reads Total due $0.00, with no lines listed.

steps.action: Click the box reading Scan or type item #, type BITTYVENOM and press Enter
steps.expected: A message Adding item and calculating total... shows briefly. The invoice then lists one line, Bitty Boomers MARVEL VENOM Bluetooth Speaker $22.19. Inventory reads $22.19, a row PP Tax reads $0.20, and Total due reads $22.19. The Continue button is available.

steps.action: Click the small information icon at the start of the Bitty Boomers MARVEL VENOM Bluetooth Speaker line on the invoice
steps.expected: A panel opens headed Item detail BITTYVENOM with the item name Bitty Boomers MARVEL VENOM Bluetooth Speaker and three sections: Item details, Price adjustment and Tax settings. The Tax settings section reads Note: Tax is applied to the discounted price and lists Price $19.99, Tax $2.00, PP Tax $0.20, Discount ($0.00) and Final price $22.19. Two buttons are offered: Remove from invoice and Update item (greyed out).

steps.action: Click the X at the top right of the panel
steps.expected: The panel closes. The invoice is unchanged: one line of $22.19, a PP Tax row of $0.20 and Total due $22.19.

steps.action: Stop here - do NOT click Continue and do not take any payment
steps.expected: Nothing further is checked.

test_cases.name: As a Metro by T-Mobile authorized dealer, I want an invoice with two different accessories to show one PP Tax amount that adds both items together and to ask the customer for the full total, so that the customer is charged exactly what the screen shows

## What this test is about
